entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Immortal wizard who goes mad about every century and is manipulated by Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer, once a lowly Kjeldoran soldier, whose ring belonged to Mairsil the Pretender; he is shredded by Leshrac.

entities.name: Mairsil the Pretender
entities.description: Jodah's ancient enemy, whose ring merged with Lim-Dûl's personality.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Jodah's old friend who rescues him and cures him with his mirror.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who heals Jodah in exchange for payment and plans the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who forces Lim-Dûl into his service, seeking to use the rogue plane to escape the Shard.

entities.name: Márton Stromgald
entities.description: General who sent Lim-Dûl on the journey into the blizzard; now zombified.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Krov mage who kept Jodah's mirror and sold out Jodah; devoured by undead.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: Gustha's cousin who helped sell out Jodah; later put in charge of the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Belenda Danisdotter
entities.description: Jaya's old friend who helps her escape Krov; later a zombie killed by Jaya.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor, target of a coup.

entities.name: Avram Garrison
entities.description: Highest military commander of Kjeldor who plans a coup; becomes a zombie and is killed by Varchild.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: Second in command who helps foil the coup and kills Avram Garrison.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's most trusted lieutenant, defeated by Jaya.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Inventor whose weather-predicting machine shows the Ice Age worsening.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Rebels manipulated by Lim-Dûl and later zombified.

entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: Ice kingdom fought by Lim-Dûl's minions.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Land of barbarians allied with Kjeldor against Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's citadel.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Kjeldoran city.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world covered in ice after the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: The Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion at Argoth that ended the Brothers' War and sent Dominaria into an Ice Age.

entities.name: The World Spell
entities.description: Freyalise's spell, a reverse Sylex Blast, that ends the Ice Age.

events.summary: In the prologue, the Kjeldoran soldier Lim-Dûl, trapped in a blizzard, finds a strange powerful ring in a cave.
events.quote: He manages to stumble into a small cave, where he finds a strange, powerful ring.

events.summary: Jodah awakens at Tresserhorn and is told he is a summoned copy who must obey Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: The necromancer tells him he's a summoned copy of the original Jodah

events.summary: Jodah meets the zombified Márton Stromgald.
Leshrac mutates Lim-Dûl, revealing he forced the necromancer into his service.
events.quote: Leshrac mutates the necromancer by making him more animalistic and giving him horns

events.summary: Jaya reveals Jodah is the real Jodah, drugged by Lim-Dûl, and they escape Tresserhorn.
events.quote: Jodah is not a summoned being but the real thing

events.summary: Jodah goes mad; Jaya summons Freyalise, who explains his periodic madness and offers a cure for a price.
Jaya steals Jodah's mirror in Krov and learns Gustha and Gerda sold Jodah to Lim-Dûl; she cures Jodah with it.
events.quote: Gustha and her cousin Gerda Äagesdotter were the ones who sold out Jodah to the necromancer

events.summary: Jaya discovers Avram Garrison's plot to overthrow King Darien and warns Varchild, Jodah and Gustha, who foil the coup.
events.quote: they manage to foil the coup

events.summary: The rebel Knights of Stromgald are revealed to be manipulated by Lim-Dûl, and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.
events.quote: allows the alliance with the Balduvians to be made

events.summary: Jodah puts Gerda in charge of the School of the Unseen as punishment.
Freyalise takes Jodah's mirror as payment for healing him.
events.quote: demands the last payment for healing Jodah: to borrow his mirror

events.summary: In the final battle, Jaya defeats the zombie Belenda and Chaeska; Gustha is devoured by undead while Avram, distracting her, is killed by Varchild.
events.quote: Jaya fights and defeats Belenda Dannisdotter—now a zombie, and Chaeska

events.summary: Jodah fights Lim-Dûl, revealed to be a blend of himself and Mairsil the Pretender; Lim-Dûl summons Leshrac, who rips him apart and takes him to the rogue plane.
events.quote: Leshrac rips the necromancer to shreds but keeps him alive during it all

events.summary: With their master gone, the undead drop; Freyalise invites Jodah to Fyndhorn and enlists him to vent a reverse Sylex Blast through the safe havens.
events.quote: Freyalise is planning to use the arrival of the rogue plane to create another Sylex Blast

events.summary: After the World Spell is complete, Freyalise returns the mirror and planeswalks away; the planeswalkers leave and Jodah and Jaya wonder what the new world holds.
events.quote: After the World Spell is complete, Freyalise gives Jodah his mirror back and planeswalks away.

Leshrac has forced him into his service

Gustha and her cousin Gerda Äagesdotter
